sourceDispositions.path: landingLogic: approach, brake, glide and go-around

sourceDispositions.intent: Avoid terrain structures during descent and final approach
sourceDispositions.disposition: Retain capability requirement; source nearestTerrainObjects sampling omits dynamic/placed obstacles, truncates unsorted results and estimates tops using unrotated bounding-box Z. Not proof of a clear rotor/hull corridor.

sourceDispositions.intent: Yield for changed orders, curator movement, human pilot, damage, slingload and locality loss
sourceDispositions.disposition: Use CBE exact actor/revision/lease ownership. Source checks state every0.25s while applying velocity/orientation every0.05s, has no phase deadline, and restores MOVE/PATH/height without recording mission baselines.

sourceDispositions.path: landingLogic: touchdown gear and ground anchor
sourceDispositions.intent: Stable touchdown without bounce; retain landing until onward task
sourceDispositions.disposition: Review existing CBE AnchorLocal, not import source EachFrame gear/force workers. Source anchor has no deadline and EachFrame force callback lacks locality/task checks; cleanup unconditionally restores features, cancels landing and sets height30. Do not remove current CBE flight behaviour without an explicit safe replacement.
